Chat request with response_format json_object that returns valid JSON content

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Respond with JSON only.\",\"role\":\"system\"},{\"content\":\"Give me a user object with name and age fields.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"response_format\":{\"type\":\"json_object\"}}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(request: _request)
debugPrint(result.choices())
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].message().content())
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].finishReason())
```
